what_happened.line: The Select Board voted not to renew the Kabob-alicious alcohol license effective January 1, for unpaid municipal fees and violation of town bylaws and state law.
The hearing was limited to nonpayment of sewer fees; the license holder was not present, and members cited a long history of noncompliance and prior written notice.
The Alcoholic Beverages Control Commission (ABCC) will be notified of the non-renewal.
The board will skip its January 3 meeting and meet next on January 10.

why_it_matters: A town alcohol license can be refused renewal when municipal fees such as sewer charges go unpaid, so a business's standing with the town depends on keeping those accounts current.
Skipping the January 3 meeting moves the next chance for the board to act on licenses or other business to January 10.
watch_next: Select Board's next meeting on January 10.
